title: I Will Answer When You Call
story:
A little boy was playing in the garden while his father was working nearby.

As he explored the garden, he accidentally walked farther than he intended and could no longer see his father.

For a moment, he felt afraid and did not know which way to go.

Then he called out, "Dad!"

His father immediately answered and told him where to come.

The boy followed his father's voice and soon found him.

He was relieved because he discovered that even though he could not see his father, his father could hear him.

Sometimes life can make us feel the same way.

We may find ourselves in situations where we cannot see the way forward or understand why something is happening.

We may feel alone, afraid, or overwhelmed by problems that seem too difficult to handle.

Psalm 91 reminds us of God's promise to those who call upon Him.

God says that He will answer, be with us in trouble, deliver us, and honor us.

This does not mean that God's people will never face trouble. It means that trouble does not have the power to separate us from God's presence and care.

When we call upon God, He hears us.

Sometimes He changes our circumstances, and sometimes He gives us strength to walk through them.

His answer may not always come in the way or at the time we expect, but His presence is always greater than our fear.

So when you are troubled, do not keep your worries hidden in your heart.

Call upon the Lord in prayer.

Tell Him what you are facing and trust Him to be with you.

The God who hears your call is near, and you do not have to face your troubles alone.
life_lesson: When trouble comes, call upon God with confidence. He hears your prayer, stays with you in difficult times, and gives you the strength and help you need.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for hearing me whenever I call upon You.

When I am afraid, worried, or uncertain, help me remember that You are near.

Give me courage to bring every concern to You instead of carrying it alone.

When I face trouble, strengthen me and help me trust Your presence.

If You choose to change my circumstances, help me recognize Your hand. If I must walk through difficulty, give me grace and strength to endure it.

Help me trust Your timing even when I do not understand Your answer.

Thank You for never abandoning me and for being my refuge in difficult times.

May I always turn to You first and rest in the assurance that You hear my prayer.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What trouble or concern do you need to bring to God today?

When you feel afraid, do you turn to God in prayer or try to handle everything by yourself?

How can remembering that God hears you change the way you face difficulties?
verse: He will call on Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.
